semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Chips Joint Undertaking plays a strategic role in advancing semiconductor technologies in Europe through public-private partnerships.
summary: Chips Joint Undertaking is a European public-private partnership dedicated to advancing nano-electronic chip technologies and systems. It focuses on research, innovation, skills development, and capacity building across the semiconductor value chain, involving key industry associations and European entities.
capabilities: Fostering research and innovation in semiconductor technologies
Facilitating large-scale capacity building in Europe
Aligning strategic priorities with industry needs

regional_presence.Europe: Chips Joint Undertaking operates as a strategic initiative to enhance the semiconductor ecosystem within Europe.
